import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get species columns from sample submission
species_cols = [col for col in sample_submission.columns if col != "id"]
num_classes = len(species_cols)

# Encode target variable
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
train_df["species_encoded"] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["species"])

# Prepare features
feature_cols = (
    [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
)

X_train_raw = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train = train_df["species_encoded"].values
X_test_raw = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split training data for proper validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=42
)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_raw)

# Convert validation labels to one-hot for metric calculation
y_val_one_hot = np.eye(num_classes)[y_val]

# Grid search for best hyperparameters on holdout validation
param_grid = {
    "n_estimators": [50, 100, 200],
    "max_depth": [2, 3, 4],
    "min_samples_leaf": [2, 5, 10],
    "learning_rate": [0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
}

grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42),
    param_grid,
    cv=3,
    scoring="neg_log_loss",
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=0,
)

grid_search.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)
best_params = grid_search.best_params_

# Train final model on holdout training data (NOT on validation data)
final_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(**best_params, random_state=42)
final_model.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)

# Predict probabilities on test set
y_test_proba = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(y_test_proba, columns=species_cols)
submission_df["id"] = test_ids

# Sort by id
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values("id").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to submission directory
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Compute and print validation metric
y_val_proba = final_model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_one_hot, y_val_proba)
print(f"{val_logloss:.6f}")
